description: An option bag reads only the keys its caller set. A known option that would be read through the prototype, from the bag's own prototype or from Object.prototype, is refused as an unknown one is; one the caller set is read whatever the prototype holds. Each package's tests apply these cases to every option check it has, with a key that check reads. Refused means the call throws an error saying the option is inherited.

cases.name: set by the caller and on the bag's prototype
set by the caller and on Object.prototype
